places.method: 13 bounding-box tiles; deduplicated by OSM object ID; brickyard sites within approximately 100 m of a mapped kiln represented by the kiln; representative points clipped to Belauri polygon

categories.kiln: industrial or product contains brick; man_made=kiln
categories.government: office=government or amenity=townhall, plus OSM building way/1092534990 named belauri municipality kanchanpur

places.completeness: Community-mapped locations only, not a complete official inventory. Health layer includes hospitals, clinics, and health posts. Government layer includes government offices, not only municipal offices. Unnamed mapped features retain descriptive labels. Locations are current map features and are not historical 2024 locations.
